_comment: A reference tablewalk.json. Copy it, edit it, mount it — it is not built
into the image and nothing here is special.
The password is written as ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} rather than inline. That
is not decoration: the macOS keychain that credentials.ts prefers does
not exist in a Linux container, so environment expansion is the credential
mechanism for Docker. An unset variable is a startup error, not an empty
"writable" is opt-in per connection and enforced by the server, not by
the browser's toggle. Leaving it false is the right default for a file a
colleague may have copied without reading every line of.
The aggregate clauses name their child table as public.invoice_line, not
invoice_line. On Postgres a table's id is schema-qualified, and an
aggregate resolves the child by id — the base table is the one place a
bare name is accepted. Getting this wrong is not silent: the view comes
back from /api/views carrying its own error, which names the fix.
Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the loader, which is why this
comment can live in a file that has no comment syntax.
_surfaces: Beside `connections`, a config file can carry the surfaces a team agrees
on — so they live in version control rather than in one person's browser.
`views` are saved filters, `queries` named SQL, `pages` composed records,
and `layouts` how the record view arranges one table.
A list section names its relationship as `from` + `whose` (the child
table, and the column of it whose value names this record) or as `via`,
the constraint name. The pair is resolved against the schema; one that
matches nothing keeps its section and carries an error rather than
disappearing. `show` says which fields or columns, `sort` reads like the
query bar — the same words a page section uses.
A committed layout fills in for a table nobody has laid out here, and
never over one somebody saved in the browser.

views.name: Recent invoices
views.text: invoice show id, invoice_date, total, customer_id.name as customer, customer_id.country_code.name as country count public.invoice_line via invoice_id as lines sort invoice_date desc limit 50

views.name: Active customers by value
views.text: customer show name, email, country_code.name as country, credit_limit count public.invoice via customer_id as invoices sum public.invoice.total via customer_id as billed where active = true sort credit_limit desc limit 100
